subject: Post-demo: access certification asks, SSO/SCIM evidence & next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@upwellhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo recap & initial asks for SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence

Hi Marco — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary from our side:
- You’re evaluating Redwood to replace an internal endpoint layer for document generation and content workflows; primary concerns are identity integration, admin controls, and regulatory posture (HIPAA + SOC 2).
- Current SSO: Okta (SAML 2.0).
- Looking for SCIM provisioning, scoped RBAC for admins, and audit logs retention details.

Immediate asks we heard: 
1) Confirmation of Redwood’s SOC 2 status and timeline to provide SOC 2 Type II report (if available).
2) A checklist of identity artifacts we can provide quickly to your security team so procurement can progress.
3) A proposed schedule for a hands-on SSO test in a sandbox (Okta test connector + SCIM push).

Proposed next steps: 
- I’ll put together an artifact checklist and timelines (targeting EOD tomorrow).
- Can we get an internal contact on your security or compliance team (or procurement) to share any vendor questionnaire they want us to prioritize?

Attachments: none on this note — I’ll send a short artifact pack in the next message.

Thanks again,

— Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0199
From: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@upwellhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@upwellhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & initial asks for SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence

Soojin — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) SOC 2: We require evidence of existing SOC 2 compliance (Type II preferred). If you have a SOC 2 report or SOC 2 letter of attestation, please indicate whether it covers the Hosted API environment.
2) GDPR / HIPAA: We need confirmation that you support data processing agreements and that you have HIPAA BAAs available.
3) Identity specifics: Confirmed — Okta SAML 2.0 for SSO. For provisioning we use SCIM and would like automated provisioning of users + group membership. We also need to see an RBAC matrix (which roles can create/delete API keys, manage org settings, view audit logs).
4) Timeline: Procurement would like a candidate artifact pack (SOC 2 letter, SSO config checklist, SCIM mapping template, RBAC role matrix) within 5 business days if possible.

Also — will need a short window to run an Okta connector against a Redwood sandbox. Who would own that setup on your side?

If you can copy me on the artifact pack and also share a link to any documentation pages for SSO and provisioning, that will help us triage internally.

Thanks,
Marco Ruiz
VP, IT Operations
Upwell Health
marco.ruiz@upwellhealth.com
